title: Algebra Foundations: Real Numbers, Order of Operations, Expressions | Algebra I, Unit 1 (with Worked Examples)
description:
Start Algebra I here. Meet the real number family and the number line, use the order of operations, work with variables and expressions, apply the commutative, associative and distributive properties, and combine like terms. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
